result_review_limits: This is source/generated verification, not an actual010/020/025 result review.

Public-bound insetting can discard source-positive anatomy; nearest-neighbour resampling can omit small labels even inside the crop. Actual counts, volume changes and source-positive centres outside must remain visible in eligibility and intended-use decisions.
source_samples_equal audits native decode before resampling; it does not say resampled labels equal the native array.
The resource estimate remains an estimate. Root supervision and actual saved terminal evidence establish the attempt resource outcome.
No source annotation, support or cohort role is modified; no clinical anatomical accuracy or registration claim.
reviewed_delta: Only run_crop changes among prior functions; added mr_sampling_crop and resample_binary_nn. Other reviewed validation/source/sample helpers are structurally unchanged.

Output uses original MR sampling and exact native crop values/affine. Public cerebrum grid world bounds alone select crop. Uniform one-cell-per-face inset continues until all derived target cell corners are inside public source coverage; no private positive extent selects it.
Separate derived planning affine uses an explicit polar roundoff projection with at-most.001mm whole-crop cell-corner displacement. MRI samples are not interpolated.

Nearest source-centre labels and domain indicators are calculated one target XY plane at a time with floor(index+.5) and half-open native source coverage. Scalar world-coordinate oracle, anisotropy/obliquity, ties and domain cases pass.

Native decoded source sample equality is independently checked before label resampling. Saved placement report explicitly records resampling, native/placed positive volumes, source-positive centres outside output, source domains and possible missed subvoxel labels.
All three source-domain masks are saved for crop-mr. Public cerebrum domain must cover every output centre; private label-domain exterior remains unknown.
